subject.title: chore(deps): bump the production-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 22 updates

question: Should maintainers accept this grouped 22-production-dependency update as one compatibility batch, or split higher-risk runtime/build/CLI packages first?
rationale: The diff is mechanically clean and green, but production dependencies are used across UI routes, Convex, email/image/rendering, CLI prompts, and schema parsing, so accepting that grouped compatibility risk is a maintainer judgment.

options.title: Merge grouped batch
options.body: Accept the current Dependabot batch given clean mergeability, green CI, Vercel preview, and no concrete patch defect found.

options.title: Split high-risk packages
options.body: Ask for narrower PRs separating Convex, TanStack, sharp, and CLI/schema updates if maintainers want smaller rollback units.

recommendation.title: Merge grouped batch
recommendation.body: Accept the current Dependabot batch given clean mergeability, green CI, Vercel preview, and no concrete patch defect found.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current Dependabot grouping/package manifest baseline and is the strongest routing signal for dependency-maintenance policy.
